snippet.title: Shifting Sands | Early Access Out Now
snippet.description:
WELCOME TO THE NEXUS. EARLY ACCESS IS NOW OPEN.

The storm is moving. The wrecks are surfacing. Your shift starts now.

You leave the safety of the Nexus, walk into a desert full of wrecks, relics, bad weather, strange jobs, stranger people, and things that should have stayed buried, then try to get back before the storm resets the whole place.

Sometimes that works out.
Sometimes it does not.

Play it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3986410/Shifting_Sands/

A lot is already in. A lot is still being built. Tell us what hooked you, what confused you, and what made you say one more run when that was clearly a lie.

We will be updating and talking on Discord and Steam.
